qxb-equity-penetration 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides in-depth analysis of enterprise equity structures using Qixinbao data.
- Supports direct and indirect shareholder queries, including shareholding percentages and layered structures.
- Includes detailed shareholder penetration paths for transparency.
- Requires QXBENT_API_TOKEN environment variable for API access.
- Quick start instructions and dependencies included for Node.js usage.
